name: spinner
purpose: Indeterminate loading indicator: a role="status" region with a decorative rotating icon and a localized label that is announced politely when it appears. An optional delay avoids flicker for fast operations.
whenToUse: Short waits of unknown duration (loading a panel, saving).
Inside a busy region (aria-busy) as the announced status next to Skeleton placeholders.
whenNotToUse: Blocking the whole page: prefer skeletons or inline progress.
Inside buttons as the only feedback without a label.
states: pending (delay not yet elapsed; region empty)
responsive: Inline-level; the icon uses icon-size tokens by size (sm/md/lg).
rtl: Logical gap between icon and label; rotation direction is not mirrored.
theme: Icon uses color-primary; label uses color-text. Forced-colors mode uses CanvasText.
security: The label is rendered with textContent. No inline styles.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: Tested with one spinner per region; many simultaneous spinners are an anti-pattern.

limitations: The label is announced when content is inserted into the pre-existing status region; with delay 0 the region and content appear in the same task, so some screen readers may not announce it. Use a delay, or create the spinner on an empty host before the operation starts.
antiPatterns: Spinners without a meaningful label for long operations.
Showing a spinner for operations that complete in under the delay (set delay instead).
